listen_address.description: IP address the server should listen on (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

port.description: Port number for NNTP connections (119 for unencrypted, 563 for NNTPS when TLS is enabled)

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed

messagebase_path.description: Absolute path to the JAM messagebase directory

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections (requires valid cert/key files)

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate chain file (PEM format)

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format, unencrypted)

log_level.description: Minimum severity level to log (debug = most verbose, critical = least)

log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in megabytes) of the log file before rotation

log_retain_count.description: Number of old log files to keep after rotation

expire_enabled.description: Enable automatic article expiration based on retention policies

expire_default_days.description: Default number of days to retain articles (used when group-specific expiry not set)

access_groups.description: List of access control groups defining who can connect and their permissions

name.description: Unique name for the access group

allowed_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to connect (use 'all' to allow anyone)

perms.description: List of permissions for this group: 'read', 'post', or 'admin'

server_greeting.description: Custom welcome message displayed to clients upon connection
